calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for DJ.Studio
calls.summary: The team discussed the evaluation of GrowthBook as a potential unified A/B testing solution aimed at improving efficiency by combining marketing and product experimentation. Current separate workflows for marketing funnel tests and in-app feature tests highlighted the need for a single tool. GrowthBook's capabilities in code-based experimentation align with team preferences, emphasizing flexibility over visual editors. Integration with existing analytics tools like BigQuery, which avoids adding new data stores, was discussed, along with user-friendly statistical analysis for non-technical stakeholders. Cost considerations compared to Mixpanel, currently viewed as expensive, revealed that GrowthBook might provide a more cost-effective alternative. A flexible pricing model based on experiments rather than traffic was highlighted as a key advantage as teams grow.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, BigQuery, Mixpanel, Experimentation
calls.action_items:
**Reint Jan Hoiting**
Evaluate GrowthBook by starting hands-on testing to understand its capabilities and fit for DJ Studio's experimentation needs (28:00)

**Fleur van der Laan**
Review available product screenshots and online resources to visualize GrowthBook's user interface and dashboard features (22:00)

**James Shannon**
Send Fixer case study demonstrating email optimization and cloud code experimentation success to DJ Studio team (06:20)
Provide detailed documentation and best practices for integrating GrowthBook with BigQuery fact tables to support DJ Studio's data architecture (16:30)
Share timeline and details about upcoming EU server hosting availability to address DJ Studio's privacy and data residency concerns (13:30)
Follow up with DJ Studio on clarifications about GrowthBook’s pricing model changes and support offerings to assist in their budgeting and planning (26:30)
Offer onboarding and enterprise support options to DJ Studio as they scale their experimentation program with GrowthBook (27:00)
